sections.title: What changes in multiplayer?
sections.intro: Your character. Your save. One shared adventure.

items.title: Save your character
items.text: Everyone keeps their own save. The server holds no replacement. Save often.

items.title: Keep one campaign leader
items.text: The same leader handles quest dialogue, scenes and items, and enters first. Everyone can fight and solve puzzles.

items.title: Menus stay live
items.text: Our setup does not pause. Get out of danger before opening menus.

items.title: Death means respawning
items.text: Normally respawn nearby outdoors or at the indoor entrance. Extra gold-loss penalty: zero. Crime bounties still apply. Exact party setup not tested yet.

items.title: Master for everyone
items.text: Master difficulty is enforced. Enemies do not scale with party size. Combat experience sharing excludes crafting.

items.title: Watch friendly NPCs
items.text: Player damage to players and killcams are off. Lock-on targets hostiles only. Followers and townsfolk can still be hurt.

blocks.title: Keep this campaign together
blocks.text: Keep characters together in progress. Use separate characters for other campaigns, including a smaller-party night. Finish Helgen offline before connecting.

sections.title: Build your character
sections.intro: Eighteen skills, no fixed classes. Better Vanilla Perks changes trees; Imperious replaces racial packages. Every race learns every skill.

blocks.title: Use our shared collection
blocks.text: Install the agreed revision. Mentioned mods are not automatically approved.
Read changed perk tooltips before spending points.

blocks.title: Skip these until tested
blocks.text: Hold: do not use until testing and a rule change.

sections.title: Our spell mod is Mysticism
sections.intro: Heard Apocalypse mentioned earlier? Our selected mod is Mysticism: familiar spells rebalanced, new choices, the same five schools.

items.title: Alteration
items.text: Vanilla: protection and utility. Mysticism adds enemy debuffs. Mark and Recall travel are held.

items.title: Conjuration
items.text: Vanilla: bound weapons, summons, raised corpses. Mysticism adds summons, including skeletons. One active summon per player; corpse raising held.

items.title: Destruction
items.text: Vanilla: elemental attacks. Mysticism expands progression and drain spells, including Vampiric Bolt and Blood Lance.

items.title: Illusion
items.text: Vanilla: stealth, morale, mind control. Mysticism expands choices. Enemy-control spells cannot control human players.

items.title: Restoration
items.text: Vanilla: healing, wards, undead defense. Mysticism expands support. Start with Healing Hands, Heal Other and Grand Healing.

blocks.text: Buy spell tomes from usual vendors. Staff builds are welcome; extra staff skill experience is not included.

blocks.title: Support isn't a completed test
blocks.text: Ordinary healing, Courage, Rally and Call to Arms have player-target support. Exact targeting, experience and perk scaling are not tested yet. Custom auras and undead healing are not automatically player heals.

blocks.title: Main Mysticism only
blocks.text: Hold Mark, Recall and corpse reanimation. Exclude NPC spell distribution and optional Jump, Survival, Ordinator and Slower Unlocks packages.

items: Hold: don't use until testing and rule change.
Conditional: stated limits only; not tested yet.
Blocked: outside setup; don't install independently.

blocks.title: Slow time affects everyone
blocks.text: Slow time syncs; holds protect pacing pending testing.
Ordinator and Apocalypse excluded. Holds aren't inevitable-crash claims.
